change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited의 무균 주사제에서 반복적인 가시성 미립자 오염과 부적절한 조사·위험평가·공급업체 관리가 확인되었다. 로피바카인 주사제 일부 로트는 Field Alert Report 및 회수 대상이 되었으며, 품질부서 권한 강화, 전면적인 일탈·시험실·문서 시스템 평가와 CAPA가 요구된다. 제조·검사·출하 판단 전반에 환자안전과 공급 지속성 영향이 크다.

impact_summary.value: FDA는 제조·관리 방법이 CGMP에 부합하지 않아 해당 의약품이 불량(adulterated) 의약품에 해당한다고 설명하며, 입자 오염은 환자에게 중대한 건강 위험을 초래할 수 있다고 밝혔습니다.

evidence.quote: Because your methods, facilities, or controls for manufacturing, processing, packing, or holding do not conform to CGMP, your drug products are adulterated within the meaning of section 501(a)(2)(B) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FD&C Act), 21 U.S.C. 351(a)(2)(B).

The presence of particulate matter in epidural injectable products can pose significant health risks to patients. These risks are of particular concern for patients receiving long-term epidural therapy.

affected_work.value: 로피바카인 염산염 주사제 등 멸균 주사제의 입자 오염 조사와 육안검사, 폴리프로필렌 백을 포함한 자재 공급업체 적격성 및 자재 품질관리, 실험실 시험·기록관리, 품질부서의 감독과 배치 처분 업무가 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: Your firm failed to conduct an adequate investigation into recurring problems with visible particulate matter contamination. In 2024, your firm initiated an investigation when two batches of ropivacaine hydrochloride injection, supplied in polypropylene bags, exceeded your acceptance criteria for visual inspection.

A comprehensive, independent review of your materials system, including but not limited to: o An evaluation of all suppliers of materials (components, containers, and closures) to determine if they are reliable and appropriately qualified.
A comprehensive assessment of your laboratory practices, procedures, methods, equipment, documentation, and analyst competencies.

recommendation.value: FDA는 조사·일탈·불만·규격일탈 결과 관리체계, 자재 및 공급업체 관리, 육안검사 결함 분류, 품질부서의 권한·자원, 실험실 운영과 기록관리 전반을 평가하고 시정 계획을 제출하라고 요구했습니다. 또한 환자 위험평가 절차를 보완하고, 관련 인력을 교육하며, 생산·유통되는 로트의 가시 입자 관리에 임시 조치와 통제를 두라고 요구했습니다.

evidence.quote: A comprehensive assessment of your overall system for investigating deviations, discrepancies, complaints, out-of-specification results, and failures. Provide a detailed action plan to remediate this system.
Identification of interim steps and controls to ensure lots being produced and distributed into U.S. commerce are essentially free of visible particulate matter.

Revision of your risk assessment procedures to ensure thorough evaluation of potential patient impact, and address factors including but not limited to route of administration, patient population, and particle characteristics. Training for all relevant personnel on revised policies, procedures, and other associated items.
After you receive this letter, respond to this office in writing within 15 working days.
